title: Package Deductible Rewards Credit Cap, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Package benefit.** The credit cap that limits a Deductible Rewards claim-free credit under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage depends on the package of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy: on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Premier the credit cap is the option's collision deductible; on a policy written on Cardinal Auto Preferred it is the option's Deductible Rewards maximum credit raised by 250; on every other package it is the option's Deductible Rewards maximum credit.

The package is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record.

## Credit cap by package and option (USD)

| Deductible option | Collision deductible | Option maximum credit | Cardinal Auto Premier | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Every other package |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Physical Damage $2,000 Deductible | 2000 | 0 | 2000 | 250 | 0 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $1,000 Deductible | 1000 | 500 | 1000 | 750 | 500 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $750 Deductible | 750 | 500 | 750 | 750 | 500 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $500 Deductible | 500 | 500 | 500 | 750 | 500 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $250 Deductible | 250 | 250 | 250 | 500 | 250 |
| Cardinal Physical Damage $100 Deductible | 100 | 0 | 100 | 250 | 0 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical balances)

- $1,000 option on Cardinal Auto Premier, balance 700.00: cap 1000, room 300.00.
- $1,000 option on Cardinal Auto Preferred, balance 700.00: cap 750, room 50.00.
- $1,000 option on Cardinal Auto Basic, balance 700.00: cap 500; the cap less the balance is below zero, so the room is 0.00.
